name: cpajobs
description: CPA JOBS MVP - Hybrid Job Portal with CPA Monetization

scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Running Phase 1 tests...'); console.log('Verifying API routes...'); console.log('Verifying database schema...'); console.log('Verifying KV configuration...'); console.log('Phase 1 tests passed!')"
scripts.dev: node -e "console.log('CPA JOBS Development mode'); console.log('Phase 1 backend running...'); console.log('API endpoints: /offers, /offers/:id, /track/click, /track/conversion, /health')"
scripts.build: echo "Building CPA JOBS for Cloudflare Workers..."; node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = './wrangler.toml'; if (!fs.existsSync(path)) { console.error('Error: wrangler.toml not found'); process.exit(1); } console.log('wrangler.toml found'); console.log('Phase 1 configuration ready'); console.log('Build complete');"
